items.title: DigiCert data breach exposes customer information, identity documents
items.excerpt: DigiCert warns it suffered a data breach after a server migration mistakenly exposed an internal business system to the internet, allowing unauthorized access to customer information and identity documents. [...]

items.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions
items.excerpt: DreamHost is warning of a data breach after attackers gained access to its File Manager platform for two months and stole customers' FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. [...]

items.title: Chainalysis warns all users hit in cyber breach involving ‘agentic’ techniques
items.excerpt: Chainalysis, the blockchain analytics company, said Wednesday night that some information belonging to all its users — which its website says include those in the law enforcement and national security sectors — had been exposed in a cyberattack.

items.excerpt: A 3AM ransomware affiliate targeted a school estate in the UK and successfully encrypted around 37 of nearly 50 machines reached from an unmanaged host. [...]

items.title: Harvard University data breach exposed info of 851,000 accounts
items.excerpt: Hackers who breached Harvard University's Alumni Affairs and Development systems in November 2025 stole data linked to more than 850,000 unique email addresses, according to breach notification service Have I Been Pwned. [...]
